## 4. Gotchas the next agent MUST know

- **Parallel Antigravity agent** auto-commits to `beta`; always `git pull`/`git fetch` before pushing.
  It also flips the **global** `gh` active-account (shared with Elena's evercred) — but as of
  2026-07-23 that **no longer affects w0m**: gh is scoped to a dedicated **`GH_CONFIG_DIR`
  (`~/.config/gh-w0m`, casualuser-pinned)**, exported by the `justfile` and `wom7web/.husky/pre-push`,
  so every w0m `gh`/ticket-sync call selects casualuser regardless of the global active account
  (the analog of the `~/.gitconfig` includeIf that already pins git/ssh). The pre-push identity
  gate now validates *that* dir. If it ever complains, run **`just gh-w0m`** (self-provisions the
  dir + re-asserts). Only the DEFAULT `~/.config/gh` still flips; w0m ignores it.
- **🔴 HOLD — do not land the BridgeRoad `clients-policy.json` registration until [[T265]] AC1.**
  Owner decision 2026-08-31: **T265 stays half-managed.** An AGY agent registered BridgeRoad the
  same evening with **`role: "client"`** — that is the *full* client tier, the same value carried by
  1945, artemio, servicios777 and personaje0, and it puts BridgeRoad under governance the owner
  just declined (T265 AC4: no ticket sync, no GitHub mirroring, no T-ids). `role` has no
  half-managed value yet; **creating it IS AC1**, so the registration has to wait for it rather
  than borrow the nearest available word.
  Two factual defects in the same entry, both measured: `root` is `_proj/bridgeroad`, which is
  **not a git repo** (real root is `_proj/bridgeroad/BridgeMvp`, remote `BridgeRoad/bridgeroad-app`,
  branch **`dev`**), and the note claims *"On `main`"*.
  ⚠️ `just client-inventory` is **RED** while this stands — exit 2, *"registry integrity —
  measurement not attempted"*. It refuses to measure rather than reporting zero, which is correct.
  🔴 **The trap: fixing only the root turns the gate GREEN with the tier still wrong.** The
  inventory validates that a declared root resolves to a repo root; it cannot validate the tier,
  because the half-managed role does not exist for it to check against. Green here would mean
  *"the path resolves"*, not *"the tier is right"* — so do not read a passing `client-inventory`
  as approval of `role: "client"`.
- **🔴 Migration history drift (hit 2026-07-23).** `supabase db push` **fails** — the remote
  `supabase_migrations.schema_migrations` has ~6 version stamps from 2026-07-23 (e.g. `20260723043921`)
  with **no local file** (the parallel agent applies via the Supabase MCP, which records a version but
  lands no file). The CLI then suggests `supabase migration repair --status reverted <those>` — **DO
  NOT run it**, it corrupts remote history. Instead apply your migration files **directly via psql**
  in a transaction and `INSERT` the `(version, name)` row into `schema_migrations` yourself. Always
  dry-run first: wrap in `BEGIN; \i <file>; <assert end-state>; ROLLBACK;`. `$DATABASE_URL` must be
  expanded by infisical's injected env, so wrap in `sh -c` (`infisical run … -- sh -c 'psql "$DATABASE_URL" …'`),
  not the outer shell. **For any non-trivial SQL, put it in a `.sql` file and run `psql … -f <abs-path>`**
  — it sidesteps all nested-quote pain. ⚠️ the `just db-psql` / `db-psql-ssl` recipes are **broken**
  (their inner `'\\dt'` quoting throws `unexpected EOF`); use the `infisical run … -- sh -c 'psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f …'`
  form directly instead. (Supabase MCP `execute_sql` was NOT connected 2026-07-23 — psql was the only path.)
- **🔴 Staging a test file re-runs oxlint + semgrep on the WHOLE file** (pre-commit scans staged
  files, not just the diff), so **pre-existing** findings in untouched lines block your commit. Hit
  this on `tests/bot_{security,chaos}_steps.ts`. You cannot `--no-verify`. Fix them: unused param →
  `_param`; `new Array(n)` → `Array.from({length:n})`; useless regex escapes inside `[...]`
  (`[\*\_]`→`[*_]`); `console.error(\`…${x}\`)` → separate args. For genuine false positives use an
  inline **`// nosemgrep: <full.rule.id>`** — it must be on the **same line as the match** (an
  immediately-preceding-line comment is unreliable; a 2-line comment block does NOT work), and it
  **survives oxfmt**.
- **Secret-store verification without reading values:** `supabase secrets list` returns **SHA-256
  digests** → prove a store holds an expected key via `printf %s "$K" | shasum -a 256`. Cloudflare
  worker secret **values are write-only** (`wrangler secret list` = names only) — unverifiable
  directly, fall back to behavioural checks. Memory `[[secret-store-verification-methods]]`.
- **Pre-push auto-sync:** pushing a commit that touches `project/tickets/*.md` or `TASKS.md`
  fires a **background** GitHub ticket-sync (`.git/w0m-ticket-sync.log`) — non-blocking; it backfills
  `gh_issue` into ticket frontmatter (expect that follow-up diff). ⚠️ **It will NOT close your GH
  issue**, and foreground `just sync-tickets` takes >5 min over the full board. At archive time close
  the one issue directly — `GH_CONFIG_DIR=~/.config/gh-w0m gh issue close <n> --repo
  casualuser/webomage.com --reason completed --comment "…"` — then verify with `--json state`.
- **oxfmt auto-writes** on pre-commit (JS/TS/Svelte) + re-stages — no manual `oxfmt --write`; a commit
  may reformat files.
- **Tech-debt advisory** on pre-push warns if a push adds `TODO/FIXME/HACK` markers.
- **Deploy** from `wom7api/` only; needs a valid `infisical` session (`check-infisical` guards it).
- **`deno.lock`** churn: **diff first, don't blind-revert** — if specifiers/versions changed while
  `package.json` is unmodified, the committed lock was stale → regenerate + commit (see
  memory `deploy-pipeline-gotchas`).
- Ticket-sync sources from **`.md` frontmatter** (not a manifest); `just sync-tickets` runs it manually.

- **GREP `TECH-DEBT.md` BEFORE FILING A ROW.** D24 was filed as a duplicate of the existing **D7**

- **`wom7skills` has NO justfile** — its recipes (`skill`, `skill-test`, `skills-typecheck`,
  `skills-sync`, …) live in **`wom7api/justfile`**, so running `just` from `wom7skills` fails with
  *"no justfile found"*. And **`just skill …` targets the directory you RUN it from** (the recipe
  passes `--project {{ invocation_directory() }}`) — the cwd is an argument, not a convenience.
  A fresh clone of `wom7skills` also needs **`pnpm install`** before the `skills-drift` hook or
  `just skills-sync` will work.

**🔴 Measurement traps that have each cost a session.** *(Consolidated here from four dated
`Gotchas that BIT …` blocks by [[T174]] — the blocks are archived, these are the items still true.)*

- **A shell `cd` is silently RESET by `npx`/`pnpm` calls.** After one, the Bash cwd jumps back to the
  workspace root, so the *next* relative-path command measures the wrong tree. This produced a false
  **all-differs** result across a whole content diff — every file "differed" only because our side did
  not exist at that path. ⇒ **Use absolute paths for any comparison a conclusion depends on, and be
  suspicious of a uniform result.**
- **`shasum`/`diff` on a MISSING file yields an empty hash, not an error** — which reads as "differs".
  Assert the input exists before concluding anything from it.
- **`grep -c` returning 0 SHORT-CIRCUITS a `&&` chain** (grep exits 1 on no matches), so the rest
  never runs and you get a half-answer that looks complete. **A pipe masks exit status too** —
  `cmd | tail` reports *tail's* status, so a failing command can print `exit=0`. Capture status
  explicitly, or redirect to a file and check `$?`.
- **An unanchored count inside a regex assertion is a time bomb.** `assert.doesNotMatch(out, /0
  managed/)` guarded against a vacuous gate and became a false failure the moment the count reached
  **70** — because *"70 managed"* contains *"0 managed"*. Use `\b`. Any assertion matching a number as
  a **substring** will eventually fire on a different number.
- **`git mv` on a vendored dir re-stages the WHOLE file, so pre-existing lint findings block your
  commit — and the usual escape hatches are unavailable.** An inline `# nosemgrep` edits vendored
  content, which breaks both its lockfile integrity hash and its byte-identity with the pinned
  upstream, i.e. the two things [[T127]] exists to protect. ⇒ For vendored files the **hook's scope**
  is the only lever.
- **OpenSpec CLI 1.6.0 rejects change names starting with a digit.** DECIDED (T119 AC4, now in
  `.w0m/sdlc.json` → `specs.naming`): keep the dated `YYYY-MM-DD-` prefix — chronology and
  backtracing beat CLI ergonomics. So: **create letter-first, then rename the directory**, and use
  **positional** commands (`openspec validate <name> --type change`); the `--change <name>` flag
  rejects dated names. `openspec list` / `validate --all` work either way.
